candidate.answerReason: Binary carries at a count of two, which is written as 10 in binary.

methods.label: Binary carrying rule
methods.explanation: Binary uses only the 2 digits 0 and 1. Whenever the count reaches 2, carry 1 to the next higher place; that is, carry 1 for every 2.
methods.levelReason: This directly states the elementary binary counting rule within Grade 7.
